_readme: A theme picks which rooms a run can use and which shapes those rooms can take.
Add a theme here, then set "theme" on an entry in sizes.json or levels.json.
Room ids must exist in rooms.json.
Shapes: "rect" (default), "round", "hex" — all three are implemented in
css/room.css and in inShape() in js/geometry.js. This list is the pool a room
draws from; a room in rooms.json can pin its own "shape" and ignore it.
A theme may list far more rooms than a house has cells (the grid holds 9).
That surplus IS the variety: each run draws a different subset.
